summary: This is a Mol Labs public report (card L28) proposing a hypothesis-testing experiment to determine whether taurine's longevity/healthspan benefits are solely dependent on the TauT/Slc6a6 transporter, or whether residual benefits persist under TauT loss-of-function or pharmacological block. The document is a research discussion/proposal at TRL 1–2, framing a pre-registered rodent metabolic/healthspan panel as the primary kill path, with all key experimental outcomes currently UNKNOWN or NOT_RUN. It synthesizes existing literature (Singh 2023, Heller-Stilb 2002, Ito 2008, Tsuboyama 2006, Ansar 2020, GES 2025) to establish that no residual-positive taurine lifespan/healthspan H2H under TauT abolish has been demonstrated.

content_blocks.title: Document Overview and Claim
content_blocks.content: Mol Labs public report for hypothesis card L28 (taut-insufficiency assumption-kill). The central claim: on a pre-registered rodent metabolic/healthspan panel (Singh/Tsuboyama-class) with exogenous taurine vs vehicle under Slc6a6 (TauT) genetic LOF or TauT-matched transport block (e.g. GES-class) that abolishes TauT-class taurine longevity/healthspan attribution, taurine still retains ≥50% of the early healthspan/metabolic improvement seen on TauT-intact concurrent controls. This is framed as an 'assumption-kill' / 'taut-insufficiency' test. Execution status: NOT_RUN. FTO status: UNKNOWN.

content_blocks.title: Scientific Background and Rationale
content_blocks.content: Taurine longevity and metabolic-healthspan benefits are often attributed to TauT/Slc6a6 necessity. Singh (PMID 37289866) grounds WT taurine-supplementation lifespan/healthspan in mice and monkeys. Tsuboyama-Kasaoka (PMID 16627576) grounds metabolic regulation. Heller-Stilb (PMID 11772953) and Ito (PMID 18407290) establish TauT KO necessity tools for retina and heart respectively. However, no matched residual-positive taurine lifespan/healthspan H2H under TauT LOF or TauT-matched block abolish has been demonstrated. The document asks whether taurine retains longevity/healthspan/metabolic phenotype once TauT-class attribution is abolished.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art Summary
content_blocks.content:
Four primary literature references are cited as public prior art (≤4):
1. Singh et al. (PMID 37289866, Science 2023): Circulating taurine declines with aging; taurine supplementation increased healthspan/lifespan in mice and healthspan in monkeys. Slc6a6-/- used as congenital deficiency model treated with D+Q/rapa — NOT an exogenous taurine residual-under-TauT-KO longevity arm. WT TauT context only.
2. Heller-Stilb et al. (PMID 11772953, FASEB J 2002): taut gene disruption → retinal degeneration, depleted tissue taurine. TauT KO retinal necessity tool; ≠ residual-positive longevity.
3. Ito et al. (PMID 18407290, J Mol Cell Cardiol 2008): TauTKO → cardiomyopathy with cardiac atrophy, depleted myocardial taurine. TauT KO cardiac necessity tool; ≠ residual-positive longevity.
4. Tsuboyama-Kasaoka et al. (PMID 16627576, Endocrinology 2006): Taurine deficiency promotes obesity; dietary taurine prevents HFD obesity (increased REE). Metabolic phenotype founding in WT context; no TauT-abolish residual arm.

Two additional references are noted as OUTSIDE public prior art (≤4):
- Ansar et al. (PMID 31903486, Hum Mol Genet 2020): Human SLC6A6 Gly399Val hypomorph (~15% transport); oral taurine corrected cardiomyopathy and arrested retinal degeneration at 24 months. Tissue residual under partial TauT deficiency; ≠ full abolish; ≠ organismal longevity residual H2H.
- GES study (PMID 40478558, IOVS 2025): GES (pharmacological TauT block) + topical taurine reversed corneal wound healing delay and LSPC senescence. Tissue/corneal residual under TauT-matched block; ≠ organismal longevity residual H2H.

content_blocks.title: Proposed Experimental Design (Assay Proposal)
content_blocks.content: Method: propose-assay. Primary kill path: pre-registered rodent metabolic/healthspan panel (Singh/Tsuboyama-class) with taurine vs vehicle under TauT LOF (Slc6a6-/-) or TauT-matched transport block (e.g. GES-class), with TauT-intact concurrent controls on the same panel. Primary endpoint: early healthspan/metabolic improvement within a 6-week refute window. Full lifespan is secondary only (not a gate). Preferred sequence: cell/tissue/block-QC (confirming TauT transport / tissue-taurine uptake abolish) before new animal longevity runs. Threshold: block-arm early healthspan/metabolic improvement (taurine vs vehicle under abolish) retains ≥50% of the taurine vs vehicle early healthspan/metabolic improvement on TauT-intact concurrent controls. α/N pre-specified. No human dosing. No invented residual effect sizes.

content_blocks.title: Refute Criteria and Competing Outcomes
content_blocks.content:
Refute if: On the pre-registered rodent metabolic/healthspan panel where TauT LOF or TauT-matched transport block locks TauT-class control benefit abolished, same-panel early healthspan/metabolic improvement (taurine vs vehicle under abolish) is <50% of the taurine vs vehicle early healthspan/metabolic improvement on TauT-intact concurrent controls — meaning taurine longevity/healthspan reduces to a mere TauT-necessary bridge and the taut-insufficiency assumption-kill fails — when abolish-fail, taurine-alone-null, underpowered-strata, or assay-mismatch artifacts are ruled out.

Inconclusive (not refute) if: abolish-fail (block not actually abolishing TauT-class control benefit), taurine-alone-null on TauT-intact arm, underpowered strata, or referee-assay mismatch vs Singh/Tsuboyama-class lock.

content_blocks.title: Ablation Analysis (Critical Design Elements)
content_blocks.content:
Three critical design elements identified via ablation:
1. Abolish-lock × residual healthspan/metabolic H2H on the same panel: Without this, separate Singh/Tsuboyama phenotype LITERATURE and Heller-Stilb/Ito TauT-KO necessity LITERATURE cannot show longevity/healthspan ≠ mere TauT-sole-necessity bridge.
2. Block-arm early healthspan/metabolic improvement scored against TauT-intact taurine vs vehicle early healthspan/metabolic improvement as named comparator under the abolished-control lock: Without this, the card collapses into unmatched phenotype framing and loses the taut-insufficiency assumption-kill.
3. Discipline of L15≠L28 through L27≠L28 and soft-complete-empty≠novelty: Treating prior series (L15–L27), Singh WT TauT phenotype, Heller-Stilb/Ito necessity, Ansar/GES tissue residual, or empty PubMed as deciding residual-positive under TauT abolish would invent a result left UNKNOWN.

content_blocks.title: Differentiation from Prior Series (L15–L27)
content_blocks.content:
Explicit differentiation from prior series:
- L20 ≠ L28: TauT ≠ bulk autophagy (ATG5/7)
- L21 ≠ L28: TauT ≠ mitophagy (PINK1/Parkin)
- L22 ≠ L28: TauT ≠ AMPK primary; taurine ≠ metformin
- L23 ≠ L28: TauT ≠ GSK3
- L24 ≠ L28: TauT ≠ SGLT2
- L25 ≠ L28: TauT ≠ SIRT1
- L26 ≠ L28: TauT ≠ MT/melatonin (luzindole/Mtnr1a/b)
- L27 ≠ L28: TauT ≠ Klb/FGFR1 (CRITICAL)
- NOT NAD-after-senolysis (SERIES_FROZEN)
- L1–L27 ≠ proof of L28 residual

key_findings: Residual-positive taurine lifespan or healthspan H2H under TauT LOF or TauT-matched transport block that abolishes TauT-class control is UNKNOWN — no such experiment has been published.

Singh 2023 (PMID 37289866) establishes taurine supplementation lifespan/healthspan phenotype in WT TauT mice and monkeys; Slc6a6-/- arms used D+Q/rapa, NOT exogenous taurine residual-under-TauT-KO — WT TauT ≠ residual H2H.

Heller-Stilb 2002 (PMID 11772953) and Ito 2008 (PMID 18407290) are TauT KO necessity tools for retina and heart respectively — necessity-leaning phenocopy, NOT residual-positive longevity under TauT abolish.

Tsuboyama-Kasaoka 2006 (PMID 16627576) establishes metabolic phenotype (taurine deficiency promotes obesity; dietary taurine prevents HFD obesity with increased REE) in WT context — no TauT-abolish residual arm.

Ansar 2020 (PMID 31903486): SLC6A6 Gly399Val hypomorph (~15% residual transport) + oral taurine corrected cardiomyopathy and arrested retinal degeneration at 24 months — tissue residual under partial TauT deficiency, NOT full abolish, NOT organismal longevity residual H2H.

GES 2025 (PMID 40478558): Pharmacological TauT block (GES) + topical taurine reversed corneal wound healing delay and LSPC senescence/pluripotency suppression — tissue/corneal residual under TauT-matched block, NOT organismal longevity residual H2H.

Proposed prediction: under TauT LOF or TauT-matched block abolishing TauT-class control, taurine vs vehicle early healthspan/metabolic improvement retains ≥50% of the improvement seen on TauT-intact concurrent controls — PREDICTION gate, not yet tested.
Execution status: NOT_RUN. Time to refute: 6 weeks (early healthspan/metabolic panel). Full lifespan is secondary only.
Preferred experimental sequence: cell/tissue/block-QC confirming TauT transport/tissue-taurine uptake abolish BEFORE new animal longevity runs.
Prior art status: PARTIAL — phenotype founding and TauT KO necessity FOUND; tissue residual FOUND (outside public prior art ≤4); residual-positive organismal longevity H2H ABSENT/EMPTY.
